blinded.name: Blinded
blinded.summary: You can't see and automatically fail ability checks that require sight.
effects: You can't see
You automatically fail ability checks that require sight
Attack rolls against you have Advantage
Your attack rolls have Disadvantage
blinded.ends_when: The effect that caused the condition specifies how it ends
blinded.full_text: While you have the Blinded condition, you experience the following effects: You can't see and automatically fail any ability check that requires sight. Attack rolls against you have Advantage, and your attack rolls have Disadvantage.

charmed.name: Charmed
charmed.summary: You can't attack the charmer or target them with harmful abilities or magical effects.
effects: You can't attack the charmer
You can't target the charmer with harmful abilities or magical effects
The charmer has Advantage on ability checks to interact socially with you
charmed.ends_when: The effect that caused the condition specifies how it ends
charmed.full_text: While you have the Charmed condition, you experience the following effects: You can't attack the charmer or target the charmer with harmful abilities or magical effects. The charmer has Advantage on any ability check to interact with you socially.

deafened.name: Deafened
deafened.summary: You can't hear and automatically fail ability checks that require hearing.
effects: You can't hear
You automatically fail ability checks that require hearing
deafened.ends_when: The effect that caused the condition specifies how it ends
deafened.full_text: While you have the Deafened condition, you experience the following effects: You can't hear and automatically fail any ability check that requires hearing.

exhaustion.name: Exhaustion
exhaustion.summary: You suffer levels of exhaustion, with cumulative effects including disadvantage, reduced speed, and eventually death.
effects: Level 1: Disadvantage on ability checks
Level 2: Speed halved
Level 3: Disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws
Level 4: Hit point maximum halved
Level 5: Speed reduced to 0
Level 6: Death
exhaustion.ends_when: Finishing a long rest reduces your exhaustion level by 1 (if you have food and drink)
exhaustion.full_text: While you have the Exhaustion condition, you experience the following effects based on your exhaustion level. Level 1: Disadvantage on ability checks. Level 2: Speed halved. Level 3: Disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws. Level 4: Hit point maximum halved. Level 5: Speed reduced to 0. Level 6: Death. Finishing a long rest reduces your exhaustion level by 1, provided you have ingested food and drink.

frightened.name: Frightened
frightened.summary: You have Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while the source of fear is within line of sight.
effects: You have Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while the source of fear is within line of sight
You can't willingly move closer to the source of fear
frightened.ends_when: The effect that caused the condition specifies how it ends
frightened.full_text: While you have the Frightened condition, you experience the following effects: You have Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while the source of your fear is within line of sight. You can't willingly move closer to the source of your fear.

grappled.name: Grappled
grappled.summary: Your speed is 0, and you can't benefit from bonuses to speed.
effects: Your speed is 0
You can't benefit from any bonus to your speed
grappled.ends_when: The grappler is incapacitated, you are moved out of the grappler's reach, or you use an Action to escape (Athletics or Acrobatics check vs grappler's save DC)
grappled.full_text: While you have the Grappled condition, you experience the following effects: Your speed is 0 and can't benefit from any bonus to your speed. The condition ends if your grappler is incapacitated or if an effect removes you from the reach of your grappler. You can also use your Action to try to escape. To do so, make an Athletics or Acrobatics check against the save DC of the effect that grappled you.

incapacitated.name: Incapacitated
incapacitated.summary: You can't take any action, Bonus Action, or Reaction.
effects: You can't take any action
You can't take any Bonus Action
You can't take any Reaction
incapacitated.ends_when: The effect that caused the condition specifies how it ends
incapacitated.full_text: While you have the Incapacitated condition, you experience the following effects: You can't take any action, Bonus Action, or Reaction.

invisible.name: Invisible
invisible.summary: You can't be seen without the aid of magic or a special sense, and you are heavily obscured for the purpose of hiding.
effects: You can't be seen without the aid of magic or a special sense
You are heavily obscured for the purpose of hiding
Attack rolls against you have Disadvantage
Your attack rolls have Advantage
invisible.ends_when: The effect that caused the condition specifies how it ends
invisible.full_text: While you have the Invisible condition, you experience the following effects: You can't be seen without the aid of magic or a special sense. For the purpose of hiding, you are Heavily Obscured. Attack rolls against you have Disadvantage, and your attack rolls have Advantage.

paralyzed.name: Paralyzed
paralyzed.summary: You are incapacitated, can't move or speak, and automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
effects: You are Incapacitated
You can't move or speak
You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws
Attack rolls against you have Advantage
Any attack that hits you is a critical hit if the attacker is within 5 feet of you
paralyzed.ends_when: The effect that caused the condition specifies how it ends
paralyzed.full_text: While you have the Paralyzed condition, you experience the following effects: You are Incapacitated. You can't move or speak. You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws. Attack rolls against you have Advantage. Any attack that hits you is a critical hit if the attacker is within 5 feet of you.

petrified.name: Petrified
petrified.summary: You are transformed into a solid inanimate substance (usually stone), along with any objects you are wearing or carrying.
effects: You are transformed into a solid inanimate substance (usually stone)
Your weight increases by a factor of ten
You are Incapacitated
You can't move or speak
You are unaware of your surroundings
You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws
You have Resistance to all damage
You are immune to poison and disease
petrified.ends_when: The effect that caused the condition specifies how it ends
petrified.full_text: While you have the Petrified condition, you experience the following effects: You are transformed, along with any nonmagical objects you are wearing or carrying, into a solid inanimate substance (usually stone). Your weight increases by a factor of ten, and you cease aging. You are Incapacitated, can't move or speak, and are unaware of your surroundings. You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws. You have Resistance to all damage. You are immune to poison and disease.

poisoned.name: Poisoned
poisoned.summary: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
effects: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls
You have Disadvantage on ability checks
poisoned.ends_when: The effect that caused the condition specifies how it ends
poisoned.full_text: While you have the Poisoned condition, you experience the following effects: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

prone.name: Prone
prone.summary: You are lying on the ground. Attack rolls against you have Advantage if the attacker is within 5 feet, otherwise Disadvantage.
effects: Your only movement option is to crawl (costs 1 extra foot per foot moved)
You have Disadvantage on attack rolls
Attack rolls against you have Advantage if the attacker is within 5 feet
Attack rolls against you have Disadvantage if the attacker is more than 5 feet away
prone.ends_when: You stand up (costs half your movement speed)
prone.full_text: While you have the Prone condition, you experience the following effects: Your only movement option is to crawl, unless you stand up. Each foot of movement while crawling costs 1 extra foot. You have Disadvantage on attack rolls. An attack roll against you has Advantage if the attacker is within 5 feet of you. Otherwise, the attack roll has Disadvantage. You can end the condition by standing up, which costs an amount of movement equal to half your speed.

restrained.name: Restrained
restrained.summary: Your speed is 0, and you have Disadvantage on attack rolls and Dexterity saving throws.
effects: Your speed is 0
You can't benefit from any bonus to your speed
Attack rolls against you have Advantage
Your attack rolls have Disadvantage
You have Disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws
restrained.ends_when: The effect that caused the condition specifies how it ends
restrained.full_text: While you have the Restrained condition, you experience the following effects: Your speed is 0, and you can't benefit from any bonus to your speed. Attack rolls against you have Advantage. Your attack rolls have Disadvantage. You have Disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.

stunned.name: Stunned
stunned.summary: You are incapacitated, can't move, speak only falteringly, and automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
effects: You are Incapacitated
You can't move
You can speak only falteringly
You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws
Attack rolls against you have Advantage
stunned.ends_when: The effect that caused the condition specifies how it ends
stunned.full_text: While you have the Stunned condition, you experience the following effects: You are Incapacitated. You can't move, and you can speak only falteringly. You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws. Attack rolls against you have Advantage.

unconscious.name: Unconscious
unconscious.summary: You are incapacitated, can't move or speak, are unaware of your surroundings, and drop whatever you're holding.
effects: You are Incapacitated
You can't move or speak
You are unaware of your surroundings
You drop whatever you're holding and fall Prone
You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws
Attack rolls against you have Advantage
Any attack that hits you is a critical hit if the attacker is within 5 feet of you
unconscious.ends_when: The effect that caused the condition specifies how it ends (or you regain hit points)
unconscious.full_text: While you have the Unconscious condition, you experience the following effects: You are Incapacitated. You can't move or speak and are unaware of your surroundings. You drop whatever you're holding and fall Prone. You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws. Attack rolls against you have Advantage. Any attack that hits you is a critical hit if the attacker is within 5 feet of you.
